svg.text: How Prompt Forge spends your tokens
Three prompts, three routes. The loop replays them in order.
short reply, /command, raw:, an image or file, /forge off → sent exactly as typed, no checks

g.text: now add a test for it
now add a test for it
now add a test for it
A follow-up stays in the conversation, on your model, sent instantly as you typed it.
A new task in a long session: f clears the old conversation; small and clear, so Sonnet runs it.
Short replies, /commands, raw: and attachments pass straight through: no checks, no cost.
